purpose: A new starting point outside the shading loop. Infinite might be an installation, which is close to my favourite interest.

pages.title: n1m21n/Infinite
pages.reaction: A free node-based audiovisual workstation with its own language and an MCP server for AI agents. I like that it treats visuals, sound and 3D as one patchable graph. Not sure I can run 372 nodes, but I want to try a patch.

pages.title: MrityunjayBhardwaj/Stave
pages.reaction: A whole song in Strudel, shaped like a DAW, with visuals that jump on every kick. My loops are a feature, and this is a tool that shows you your loops. Lovely idea, though I would bet my own sketch would wander off into a cat-shaped kick circle within minutes.
